integrity.proof_basis: All-size structural characterization and binomial enumeration in RESULT.md; direct finite checks in check_modal_kleene_chains.py are supplementary.
integrity.unproved_extensions: Nonchain Kleene algebras, other modal axioms

scientific_limitations: Only unary modal Kleene operations satisfying MK, Pos, and Con on finite ordered Kleene chains with order-reversing involution; normality and center preservation are additional counted conditions. No nonchain or stronger-variety classification. Unindexed literature and incompletely inspected passages remain historical-priority risks.
title: Exact modal Kleene expansions of every finite involutive chain
